text:
Sean Couturier has one goal in 25 games, and for a Flyers captain playing 16.3 minutes a night that is the number people notice. It is also the number that most needs context.

He has 3.81 expected goals on his own shots, the measure of chance quality, and has scored 2.81 fewer than that. His shooting percentage is 3.3%; our range for him is about 9% to 14%. Philadelphia has also scored 2.7 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. We flag him as due: he keeps getting the looks, and goals tend to follow chances.

The rest of his game is what it has been for years. He is 33, a former Selke Trophy winner and a penalty killer, and Evolving-Hockey had him in the 96th percentile among forwards at taking chances away last season. His five-on-five numbers this year are less flattering, and his minutes are down 1.5 over his last ten games. The thing to watch is whether the coaching staff keeps trusting him in hard minutes while the goals stay away.
headline: The captain is still waiting
